gdacs-cyclone-tc-1001343.summary: Typhoon In-fa (JMA No. 31) brought high waves and strong winds to the Ogasawara Islands in Tokyo, Japan, around 4 to 5 November 2026. A peak gust of 25.4 m/s was recorded at Chichijima on 5 November. At 09:00 JST on 6 November 2026, it became an extratropical low east of Japan. No deaths, damage or evacuations were reported in the sources found.
